comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The way this skill works is that it refills your Stamina (life) gauge while exploring a dungeon each time you go to the next floor. At 100 Storekeeper trait points, it will completely refill your Stamina. This works not only in normal dungeons, but the two Endless Dungeons (Labyrinth/Temple of Poseidon) as well.

If you select an Aide with this skill to become your Aide Captain, you effectively no longer require any stamina restoring items, or stamina-loss reducing titles/equipment. Sadly, this skill cannot be inherited or added to other aides by any means and it only affects the player whose Aide Captain has this skill; their fleetmates will have to protect and recover their Stamina (if they even can) through other means.
